comments.author: Snipe
comments.body:
The one caught in the Nile will give the African Arowana discovery while the one caught in the Amazon will give the Black Arowana discovery.

Managing to catch an Arowana in the Nile for the first time will immediately yield the African Arowana discovery. However, it is very likely that one might need to catch plenty of Arowana in the Amazon before the Black Arowana discovery pops up

BTW these is one of the rarest fish in the Nile, and significantly rarer in occurrence than in the Amazon
